meta.note: Vectors are L2-normalised, so cosine similarity == dot product.
meta.ConsultantsCurrentlyHere: Distinct consultants on an ongoing project at this customer. Ongoing = end date in the current month or later, or no end date recorded. Sourced from consultants_per_customer.json; null if that file is absent.
meta.customerSince: Earliest recorded project start for this customer, as YYYY-MM (or YYYY when the start month is blank), across all projects in the CV export. null means no dated project was found.
